definitions.explanation: a state of agitation and confusion, often leading to irrational behavior

examples.japanese: ⟦{突然|とつぜん}→突然：00409_totsuzen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{質問|しつもん}→質問：00888_shitsumon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{狼狽|ろうばい}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I was flustered by the sudden question.

examples.japanese: {狼狽|ろうばい}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{何|なに}→何：00498_nani⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}っている→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{分|わ}からなく→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: I became so flustered that I didn't know what I was saying.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{狼狽|ろうばい}⟦ぶり→〜ぶり：28358_buri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦{何|なに}か→何か：03873_nanika⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{察|さっ}した→察する：08053_sassuru⟧。
examples.english: Seeing how flustered he was, I sensed something had happened.

notes:
FORMS:
{狼狽|ろうばい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ - to be flustered, to panic

ETYMOLOGY:
From Chinese. {狼|ろう} (wolf) and {狽|ばい} (legendary wolf-like creature) were said to be inseparable. When apart, both would panic - hence the meaning of confusion.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{慌|あわ}てる→慌てる：01874_awateru⟧ - to panic, to be flustered (more common)
- ⟦{動揺|どうよう}する→動揺する：25352_douyousuru⟧ - to be shaken, disturbed
- ⟦うろたえる→うろたえる：21630_urotaeru⟧ - to be confused, lose composure

USAGE:
{狼狽|ろうばい} is more literary and formal than ⟦{慌|あわ}てる→慌てる：01874_awateru⟧.
